textRuns.value: Medals count actual medals awarded, one per country per event per medal type, not the number of medallists. Counting rows would overstate by 2.1 times and by 4.9 times for Serbia. Countries follow the source mapping to modern states, so the Soviet Union's 1,197 medals fall under Russia and East Germany's 519 under Germany. The ratio table is limited to countries with 50 or more medals.
